```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(qqman)
library(simtrait)
library(metalcor)
library(cowplot)
```

Top 3 most inflated traits from each dataset to visualize qqplots.
Run `realdata_qqplot_samafs_pvals.R` on RCC cluster to extract SAMAFS joint + metalcor p-values.
Transfer `samafs_qqplot_pvals.txt` to DCC.
```{r fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
make_qq_df <- function(pvals, analysis, trait_name) {
  pvals <- pvals[!is.na(pvals)]
  n <- length(pvals)
  data.frame(
    expected = -log10(ppoints(n)),
    observed = -log10(sort(pvals)),
    analysis = analysis,
    trait = trait_name
  )
}

# Helper: run metalcor on male/female SAIGE files, return p-values
run_metacorr <- function(male_file, female_file) {
  df_male <- read.table(male_file, header = TRUE)
  df_female <- read.table(female_file, header = TRUE)
  study_male <- df_male %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  study_female <- df_female %>%
    dplyr::select(id = MarkerID, chr = CHR, pos = POS, beta = BETA, se = SE, n = N)
  obj <- metalcor(list(study_female, study_male), median = TRUE)
  obj$assoc$p
}

## SAMAFS data — read pre-computed joint + metalcor p-values from /home/tt207 cluster
samafs_pvals <- read.table("/hpc/dctrl/tt207/meta_analysis_aim/samafs_qqplot_pvals.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
samafs_metal_dir <- "/hpc/dctrl/tt207/meta_analysis_aim/METAL/samafs"

samafs_traits <- list(
  BMI    = "LOG_bmi_trait_age",
  Weight = "LOG_weight_trait_age",
  "Waist circumference" = "LOG_waistc_trait_age"
)

df_samafs <- data.frame()
for (trait_label in names(samafs_traits)) {
  trait_code <- samafs_traits[[trait_label]]
  joint_p <- samafs_pvals %>% filter(trait == trait_label, analysis == "joint") %>% pull(p)
  mc_p    <- samafs_pvals %>% filter(trait == trait_label, analysis == "metacorr") %>% pull(p)
  meta <- read.table(paste0(samafs_metal_dir, "/output_metal_sex_", trait_code, "1.txt"), header = TRUE)

  df_samafs <- rbind(df_samafs,
    make_qq_df(joint_p, "Joint", trait_label),
    make_qq_df(meta$P.value, "Sex-meta", trait_label),
    make_qq_df(pval_gc(meta$P.value)$pvals, "Sex-meta-GC", trait_label),
    make_qq_df(mc_p, "Sex-meta-corr", trait_label)
  )
}
## HCHS/SOL data — all files on /hpc/dctrl
hchs_saige_dir <- "/hpc/dctrl/tt207/meta_analysis_aim/hchs-sol/saige"
hchs_metal_dir <- "/hpc/dctrl/tt207/meta_analysis_aim/METAL/hchs-sol"

# Height
joint <- read.table(paste0(hchs_saige_dir, "/saige_output_HEIGHT.txt"), header = TRUE)
meta  <- read.table(paste0(hchs_metal_dir, "/output_metal_sex_HEIGHT_trait1.txt"), header = TRUE)
mc_p  <- run_metacorr(paste0(hchs_saige_dir, "/saige_output_HEIGHT_male.txt"),
                       paste0(hchs_saige_dir, "/saige_output_HEIGHT_female.txt"))
hchs_A <- rbind(make_qq_df(joint$p.value, "Joint", "Height"),
                make_qq_df(meta$P.value, "Sex-meta", "Height"),
                make_qq_df(pval_gc(meta$P.value)$pvals, "Sex-meta-GC", "Height"),
                make_qq_df(mc_p, "Sex-meta-corr", "Height"))

# BMI
joint <- read.table(paste0(hchs_saige_dir, "/saige_output_LOG_BMI.txt"), header = TRUE)
meta  <- read.table(paste0(hchs_metal_dir, "/output_metal_sex_LOG_BMI_trait1.txt"), header = TRUE)
mc_p  <- run_metacorr(paste0(hchs_saige_dir, "/saige_output_LOG_BMI_male.txt"),
                       paste0(hchs_saige_dir, "/saige_output_LOG_BMI_female.txt"))
hchs_B <- rbind(make_qq_df(joint$p.value, "Joint", "BMI"),
                make_qq_df(meta$P.value, "Sex-meta", "BMI"),
                make_qq_df(pval_gc(meta$P.value)$pvals, "Sex-meta-GC", "BMI"),
                make_qq_df(mc_p, "Sex-meta-corr", "BMI"))

# Weight
joint <- read.table(paste0(hchs_saige_dir, "/saige_output_LOG_ANTA4.txt"), header = TRUE)
meta  <- read.table(paste0(hchs_metal_dir, "/output_metal_sex_LOG_ANTA4_trait1.txt"), header = TRUE)
mc_p  <- run_metacorr(paste0(hchs_saige_dir, "/saige_output_LOG_ANTA4_male.txt"),
                       paste0(hchs_saige_dir, "/saige_output_LOG_ANTA4_female.txt"))
hchs_C <- rbind(make_qq_df(joint$p.value, "Joint", "Weight"),
                make_qq_df(meta$P.value, "Sex-meta", "Weight"),
                make_qq_df(pval_gc(meta$P.value)$pvals, "Sex-meta-GC", "Weight"),
                make_qq_df(mc_p, "Sex-meta-corr", "Weight"))

df_hchssol <- rbind(hchs_A, hchs_B, hchs_C)

## Combine into one dataframe with panel label (dataset + trait)
df_samafs$dataset <- "SAMAFS"
df_hchssol$dataset <- "HCHS/SOL"
df_all <- rbind(df_samafs, df_hchssol)
df_all$analysis <- factor(df_all$analysis, levels = c("Joint", "Sex-meta", "Sex-meta-corr", "Sex-meta-GC"))
df_all <- df_all[order(df_all$analysis), ] 
print(table(df_all$analysis))  # verify all 4 levels have data

# Combined facet label: "SAMAFS\nBMI", etc. — ordered so SAMAFS row first
df_all$panel <- paste0(df_all$dataset, "\n", df_all$trait)
panel_order <- c(
  paste0("SAMAFS\n", c("BMI", "Waist circumference", "Weight")),
  paste0("HCHS/SOL\n", c("BMI", "Height", "Weight"))
)
df_all$panel <- factor(df_all$panel, levels = panel_order)

analysis_colors <- c("Joint" = "#F8766D", "Sex-meta" = "#619CFF",
                     "Sex-meta-corr" = "#00BA38", "Sex-meta-GC" = "gold")
analysis_alphas <- c("Joint" = 0.5, "Sex-meta" = 0.5,
                     "Sex-meta-corr" = 0.5, "Sex-meta-GC" = 0.5)

fig <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = expected, y = observed, color = analysis, alpha = analysis)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = analysis_colors, name = "Analysis") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = analysis_alphas, name = "Analysis") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1))) +
  labs(x = expression(Expected~~-log[10](italic(p))),
       y = expression(Observed~~-log[10](italic(p)))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  )
fig

ggsave(
  filename = "realdata_sex-meta_GC.png",
  plot = fig,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)
```
